label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Every page starts with the same header and menu, so reaching the first product took about 9 Tab presses, and there was no skip link to the main content.
Reaching the size choice took about 22 Tab presses through the menu, breadcrumbs, six gallery image buttons and the colour links, with no shortcut past them.
Adding to the bag opened a drawer silently and keyboard focus dropped to the top of the page, so I had to read the page to learn the item was added.
Several links have no name at all, and the quantity dropdown has no clear label. Three Add to Bag buttons for the suggested items all sound identical and do not say which product they add.
To reach Continue to Checkout I had to tab through about 10 elements, including the suggested items, which risk adding unwanted products by accident.
After activating checkout the page showed nothing and no focus until I read it again, with no loading announcement.
